facts.title: Key Facts
facts.summary: {name} is the first luggage storage in Heraklion, Crete — staffed, family-run and in the city centre. It is open every day and charges {min}–{max} per bag per day.
facts.prices: {items} — per bag, per day. The drop-off and pick-up days both count.
facts.payment: Cash or card, paid at the store. No online payment.
facts.booking: Online in about 30 seconds with just a name and phone number — no account, no email. Walk-ins welcome.
facts.security: No lockers: every bag is tagged, you get a receipt, and our staff keep it in a locked room with CCTV.
facts.luggage: Any size, from backpacks to large suitcases — plus prams, bikes, surfboards, musical instruments and boxes. No food.
facts.extras: A free toilet for customers, and airport transfers arranged on request.

size.question: Is there a limit on luggage size?
size.answer: No — we accept any luggage size, from small backpacks to large suitcases, and you can mix different sizes in one booking.

specialItems.question: Can I leave a pram, bike or surfboard?
specialItems.answer: Yes. As well as suitcases and backpacks, we store prams, bikes, surfboards, musical instruments and boxes. We don't accept food, and we recommend keeping passports, medication and valuables with you.

security.question: Is my luggage safe with you?
security.answer: Yes. Every bag is tagged and you get a receipt. Our staff keep your bags in a locked storage room with CCTV, for as long as you need.

lockers.question: Do you have luggage lockers?
lockers.answer: No — every bag is handed to a person, not left in a self-service locker. We tag it, give you a receipt and keep it in a locked room with CCTV. There is no fixed compartment size, so large suitcases, several bags or a bike are no problem.

payment.question: How do I pay?
payment.answer: You pay at the store in cash or by card. There is no online payment — booking online simply reserves your spot and gives you a discount.

discount.question: How do the online discounts work?
discount.answer: Book online and get 10% off automatically — no coupon code required. Stay 3 or more days and you'll get 25% off instead.

longStay.question: Can I leave luggage overnight or for a week?
longStay.answer: Yes. Overnight, a week or longer all work the same way: you pay per bag per day, and stays of 3 days or more get 25% off when you book online. Drop-off and pick-up are during opening hours.

transport.question: How far are you from the port, the airport bus and the airport?
transport.answer: The airport bus stop is about a 1-minute walk away and Heraklion Port about 15 minutes on foot. Heraklion Airport is around 6.5 km away, and we can arrange an airport transfer for you.

groups.question: Do you offer rates for large groups?
groups.answer: Contact us directly and we'll be happy to discuss special rates for large groups.

cancel.question: What if my plans change?
cancel.answer: Nothing is paid online, so there is nothing to cancel and nothing to refund — you only pay at the store. If your plans change, just let us know on WhatsApp or by phone.

account.question: Do I need to create an account to book?
account.answer: No account, no password, no email required. Just fill in your name, phone number and storage details — it takes about 30 seconds.
